reason: The plugin is a repository-analysis utility for Git workspaces, whose primary purpose is pre-flight safety inspection before writes, commits, or pushes. Evidence in the README and package metadata shows tools that inspect branch state, upstream drift, fetch freshness, identity origin, staged/untracked changes, and duplicate checkouts to decide whether further work is safe, while emphasizing read-only default behavior and explicit optional fetching. This is best classified as project-analysis rather than code generation, media, UI, or external service integration.

summaries.zh: 该插件在写入或提交前检查 Git 工作区状态与环境一致性，报告分支、远端同步、作者身份来源、暂存/未暂存变更及本机重复克隆情况，帮助你判断是否应继续操作。
summaries.en: This plugin performs Git workspace pre-flight checks, reporting branch and remote sync state, commit author identity source, staged versus unstaged changes, and duplicate checkouts to help you decide whether it is safe to continue.

capabilities: Reads git repository metadata and working-tree status
Scans configured directories for additional git checkouts
Optionally contacts remotes when fetch mode is enabled
Reads git configuration values for identity and remote URLs

reasons.code: checkout_guard outputs branch, upstream, ahead/behind, identity source, staged/unstaged/untracked status
checkout_guard_scan discovers repositories under roots and flags those needing attention, including duplicate remote groups
Behavior is described as read-only by default with networked fetch only as an explicit option
Runtime depends on the git binary and a DSH plugin entry point, indicating local command execution over terminal/git tooling
Repository metadata (description, keywords, topics) identifies the plugin as a git pre-flight guard for agents
